name: jQuery UI DateRangePicker Widget - BEF Plugin
description: Provides a jQuery UI Date Range Picker widget for a standard core Date field as a Better Exposed Filters plugin.
project_description: The Better Exposed Filters plugin sub-module of the jQuery UI DateRangePicker Widget project. Registers a 'bef_daterangepicker' BEF filter widget that applies to a standard core Date views filter using the 'between' or 'not between' operator. It renders the jQuery UI date range picker in place of the two min/max date inputs and, via JavaScript, feeds the selected start/end into the hidden min (start 00:00:00) and max (end 23:59:59) fields. Requires the base daterangepickerwidget module and Better Exposed Filters ^7.0.
